BV generators for polynomial Weyl subalgebras — Alec Kriebel (ORCID0009-0001-9320-500X), v1.0.0 (2026-10-22), six-page preprint. For every characteristic-zero field and every nonzero polynomial h, ordinary Hochschild cohomology of A_h with its canonical cup product and Gerstenhaber bracket admits a degree-minus-one BV generator iff h is squarefree. Squarefree h admits Delta=0; repeated irreducible factors rule out every generator even without square-zero. The proof works over the original field, including nonsplit and nonmonic h; embedded h=0 is k[x] and treated separately.
